clusters.name: Teodor's death, 1978–1979
clusters.reason: Around Teodor's death in January 1978, within the following year: Delphine stopped cooking and went to her mother's every evening; Duncan took night shifts and stayed away from home; Anton began drinking at lunch with a warning at the plant; Delphine and Simone quarreled over selling the house; Callum had ear infections through the winter; and by May 1979 Delphine took a job at the library and her functioning improved. The shifts pile up from February through May 1979, each touching the others across the months, and Delphine's move to work marks where the family settled into a new balance.

clusters.name: Odette's bed rest, 1984
clusters.reason: Around March 1984 when Odette was ordered to bed for the rest of her pregnancy: Hazel came every morning to keep the house; Duncan argued with his mother over how she kept it; Callum stammered again after a year free of it; and Ines was born in September. The shifts in functioning and relationship between Hazel and Duncan, and Callum's return of his symptom, show the household under strain through these months. Ines's birth marks the end of this heightened period.

clusters.name: Hazel's Parkinson's diagnosis, 1986–1997
clusters.reason: Hazel was diagnosed with Parkinson's disease in September 1986. From November 1986 through the diagnosis, Ambrose took over cooking and her appointments; Duncan phoned his father every night for news of her; Hazel had a bad fall in 1988 and her functioning declined; Lyle and Duncan argued over who should help their parents; Ambrose developed chest pains; Hazel's functioning fell again in 1991 and 1995; Odette took her to the clinic twice a week; Mavis came to stay weekly to nurse Hazel; Duncan drank most evenings and fought with Odette over his time at his parents' house; Pearl had panic spells at the wheel; and Duncan gave up his workshop in 1996. Hazel moved to the Fairlie nursing home in June 1997 and Duncan cut his drinking back to weekends in October, marking where the family settled into a new arrangement.

clusters.name: Callum's move north, 1999–2000
clusters.reason: Callum left home for a job at the mines up north in May 1999. In the months before and after: Duncan and Callum argued most nights over his plans; Odette could not settle at the thought of him so far away; Duncan missed days at work and sat up late in the garage; Ines skipped school most of that autumn; Odette took Ines with her everywhere, even to work; and by August 2000 Ines was back at school full days and passed her exams. The shifts across these eighteen months show the household adjusting to his absence, with Ines's return to school marking where things settled.

clusters.reason: Hazel died at the Fairlie home in January 2003. Every shift in these months is yours, and no one else's shows then. Your functioning improved and your anxiety lifted as you took on the new work, marking where you settled.
